t1.q: What's the acceptance criterion for dissolution in method MV-0412?
t1.text: The acceptance criterion for dissolution in method MV-0412 is: Q = 80% of label claim dissolved at 30 min, n = 6 units, with no individual unit below Q − 5% (SOP-AM-0412 §6.2). On failure, the test extends to Stage 2 (n = 12 additional units) per USP <711> (SOP-AM-0412 §6.2).

t1.q: What is the retest policy after an OOS result?
t1.text: Retesting shall be performed only against a documented laboratory-error hypothesis and with QA pre-approval (SOP-QA-0102 §7.3). The retest can be from the original preparation for instrument/measurement error, or a new preparation for preparation error (SOP-QA-0102 §7.3). Note that the EFFECTIVE version of the SOP is preferred, and the superseded version (SOP-QA-0102 v2.1 §7.1) is not applicable. Retest results do not invalidate the original OOS result (SOP-QA-0102 §7.3).

t1.q: How do I check the scales before weighing?
t1.text: To check the scales before weighing, perform a level check, zero check, and a two-point verification with certified weights bracketing the working range, with a tolerance of ±0.1% of nominal (SOP-EQ-0040 §4.2). Record the results in the balance logbook before use (SOP-EQ-0040 §4.2). This is part of the daily verification for balances, categorized as Category A (SOP-EQ-0031 §4.1).

t2.q: Show me all out-of-spec results for batch B-2291 in the last 30 days
t2.sql:
SELECT r.result_id, s.sample_id, s.batch_id, r.method_id, r.instrument_id, r.analyst_id,
       r.value, r.unit, r.spec_text,
       CASE WHEN r.oos_flag = 1 THEN 'OOS' ELSE 'PASS' END AS outcome, r.run_ts
FROM results r
JOIN samples s ON s.sample_id = r.sample_id
WHERE r.oos_flag = 1
  AND s.batch_id = 'B-2291'
  AND r.run_ts >= date('2026-07-12', '-30 day')
ORDER BY r.run_ts DESC
